035package org.jfree.chart.entity;
036
037import java.awt.Shape;
038import java.awt.geom.Point2D;
039
040import org.jfree.chart.annotations.XYMeasurementAnnotation;
041import org.jfree.chart.annotations.XYMeasurementAnnotation.Orientation;
042
043/**
044 * A chart entity that allows to reposition an {@link XYMeasurementAnnotation}.
045 */
046public class XYMeasurementAnnotationEntity extends XYAnnotationEntity
047        implements MovableChartEntity {
048    private static final long serialVersionUID = 3673107973561822541L;
049
050    /**
051     * Creates a new entity.
052     *
053     * @param hotspot  the area.
054     * @param annotation  the annotation.
055     * @param rendererIndex  the rendererIndex (zero-based index).
056     * @param toolTipText  the tool tip text.
057     * @param urlText  the URL text for HTML image maps.
058     */
059    public XYMeasurementAnnotationEntity(Shape hotspot,
060            XYMeasurementAnnotation annotation, int rendererIndex,
061            String toolTipText, String urlText) {
062        super(hotspot, annotation, rendererIndex, toolTipText, urlText);
063    }
064
065    @Override
066    public XYMeasurementAnnotation getAnnotation() {
067        return (XYMeasurementAnnotation) super.getAnnotation();
068    }
069
070    @Override
071    public Point2D tryMove(Point2D from, Point2D to) {
072        if (getAnnotation().getOrientation() == Orientation.HORIZONTAL) {
073            // This annotation can only be moved in Y-direction
074            return new Point2D.Double(from.getX(), to.getY());
075        } else {
076            // This annotation can only be moved in X-direction
077            return new Point2D.Double(to.getX(), from.getY());
078        }
079    }
080
081    @Override
082    public void move(Point2D from, Point2D to) {
083        double offset = getAnnotation().getLabelOffset();
084        double move = getAnnotation().getOrientation() == Orientation.HORIZONTAL ?
085                from.getY() - to.getY() :
086                to.getX() - from.getX();
087        getAnnotation().setLabelOffset(offset + move);
088    }
089}
